name: Ruff
description: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust.
summary: AI tools are welcome for writing code, but a human must understand and remain responsible for everything submitted and autonomous agents may not contribute. AI must not write comments, issues, pull request descriptions or answers to maintainers, though non-native speakers may use AI to translate or edit their own comments and AI context may be quoted if clearly marked and explained.

evidence.quote: We support using AI (i.e., LLMs) as tools for coding.
However, you remain responsible for any code you publish and we are responsible for any code we merge and release.
Due to the foundational nature of our projects, we require a human in the loop who understands the work produced by AI.
**We do not allow autonomous agents to be used for contributing to our projects**. We will close any pull requests that we believe were created autonomously.
**We do not allow autonomous agents to be used for contributing to our projects**. We will close any pull requests that we believe were created autonomously.
**AI should not be used to generate comments when communicating with maintainers**. We expect comments on our projects to be written by humans.
**We do not allow autonomous agents to be used for contributing to our projects**. We will close any pull requests that we believe were created autonomously.
If you are opening an issue, we expect you to describe the problem in your own words.
If you are opening a pull request, we expect you to be able to explain the proposed changes in your own words. This includes the pull request body and responses to questions.
**Do not copy responses from the AI when replying to questions from maintainers.**
We may hide any comments that we believe are AI generated.
If you wish to include context from an interaction with AI in your comments, it must be in a quote block (e.g., using `>`) and disclosed as such.
It must be accompanied by human commentary explaining the relevance and implications of the context. Do not share long snippets.
We understand that AI is useful when communicating as a non-native English speaker. If you are using AI to edit your comments for this purpose, you must:
Take the time to ensure it reflects your own voice and ideas.
Write in your native language, and include the AI translation in a quote block beneath it.
